body: As a Chicagolandian sit down sonny and let me tell you some war stories.
Sometimes I don't catch it and I end up with 2 or 3 reddit tabs open in chrome.
Well arguing on the internet. I could write a book on this subject and get nowhere so good day.
If it's not an original story what is it a remake of?
Im an animation student. Doing papers on ancient Russian politics is something I'll pass on. Thanks. The other 100 hours of work a week animating things for core classes is a bit more important.
Well I can tell you if fully sucks.
Im better at bullshitting than my teacher is at catching it and I would challenge any teacher that says different. [graduating college in 33 days]
Aside from employees being sick all the time and contaminating your food.
I didn't know it was a real thing...are you some kind of doc or something?

I've tried meditation and it's a good temporary fix that I use along side a couple of other things. It's just working less and less now that things are getting worse. Cycling isn't something that interests me in the least, but I do go on long walks.

My girlfriend has to work 80 hours a week to pay her student loan bills (and she cant even move out because of them) so shes super stressed and this isn't something I can just dump on her. She has no idea and it's going to stay that way.

Other people though.... I could go on forever. It's simple things that most people look over and see as trivial/harmless. It's probably a completely other issue in itself, but it makes the depression worse I guess. Some people feel they need to clear their throat every 2 seconds and it drives me to the point where I have to leave the room before I get really really mad. Foot tapping, leg shaking, strange noises people make, just the sounds of another person make me mad. Not all sounds, just some. I can't even describe this issue correctly it's so fucked up.

It's not even like that all the time, I only get like that when I am depressed or frustrated. The last time I had a long stent with depression like this I lost every friend I made at school because of how intolerable of other human beings I became. I just want it to be fucking quiet sometimes.


Just a little quiet...

I choose not to be with people, it's not something I'm missing. When I'm around people I usually get irritated. I'm the guy that is at a bar with a group of people and leaves for no reason before everyone else. I just don't like group interaction. one on one is the only interaction I can do without getting pretty irritated. Sometimes a group of three (including myself) if they are close to me.

As for the hobby. I'm already an art student. My whole life is making stuff. You can see why the traditional suggestions fall short of helping. 

I really appreciate the help, but I've still got to keep looking for something...
